h1.en: Tractor 4100 vs Electric 15 Concrete Pump: 15 kW beside the Bulldozer article
h1.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15混凝土泵有何不同：对照「推土機」时，15 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Electric 15 and the Tractor-Driven 4100 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 15 lists a 15 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m and pipe 100–125 mm. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer.
directAnswer.zh: 电动15和拖拉机带动4100是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动15标出 15 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、管径 100–125 mm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer. The picture shows Bulldozer. Electric 15 and the Tractor-Driven 4100 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 15 lists no pressure and no slump. Dimensions: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Electric 15 lists 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. Electric 15 lists entries that Tractor-Driven 4100 does not: Motor power 15 kW. Vertical delivery height 15–20 m. Horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m. Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm. Open /en/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/ for Tractor-Driven 4100 and /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer。画面是Bulldozer。电动15和拖拉机带动4100是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。理论输送量：拖拉机带动4100标出 6–12 m³/h；电动15标出 8–10 m³/h。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大骨料粒径两边都是 1–3 cm。电动15有、拖拉机带动4100没有的行：电机功率 15 kW；垂直输送高度 15–20 m；水平输送距离 60–80 m；输送管内径 100–125 mm。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Electric 15 lists a 15 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m and pipe 100–125 mm. Aggregate is 1–3 cm on both. Total weight: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 1300 kg. Electric 15 lists 450 kg. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动15标出 15 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、管径 100–125 mm。外形尺寸：拖拉机带动4100标出 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm；电动15标出 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。紧凑电动底盘和拖拉机带动底盘，回答的是不同的动力问题。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: The tractor lists power 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, distance 40–100 m / 15–45 m and slump 180–220 mm. Theoretical output: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h. Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. aggregate size is 1–3 cm on both pages. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists entries that Electric 15 does not: Power 40 kW. Pumping pressure 15 MPa. Conveying distance (H / V) 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Hopper capacity 0.25 m³. Concrete slump 180–220 mm. A compact electric frame and a tractor-driven frame answer different power questions. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 拖拉机标出功率 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、距离 40–100 m / 15–45 m、坍落度 180–220 mm。整机重量：拖拉机带动4100标出 1300 kg；电动15标出 450 kg。拖拉机带动4100有、电动15没有的行：功率 40 kW；泵送压力 15 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 40–100 m / 15–45 m；料斗容积 0.25 m³；坍落度 180–220 mm。看拖拉机带动4100请打开 /zh/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/，看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does Tractor-Driven 4100 list the same theoretical output as Electric 15?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h. Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer.
answer.zh: 不一样。拖拉机带动4100标出 6–12 m³/h。电动15标出 8–10 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is power missing on Electric 15?

answer.en: The Electric 15 page does not list that label. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 40 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer.
answer.zh: 电动15这一页没有标出这个标题。拖拉机带动4100标出的是 40 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer画面里印出的数字。
